notable_absence.finding: Unlike Health Advisor (monitoring.md, health-advisor.md) and alert integrations (configure-*-integration.md, all three in this batch), this page states no plan gate at all for receiving alerts via UI or email - consistent with configure-*-integration.md's own prerequisite tip that 'analytics clusters, the Couchbase AI Data Plane, and operational clusters and App Services on the Basic plan' should fall back to exactly this page (UI/email) precisely because they lack access to third-party integrations. Confirms alerts.md is the correct universal/plan-agnostic delivery path and alert-integration.md the plan-gated one.

cross_component_finding: Auto-resolution behavior is stated concretely here for the first time in this batch: 'if the average CPU usage drops below the critical event threshold for five minutes or more, Capella automatically resolves the related alert' - a real behavior (alerts self-clear when the underlying condition ends) not present in alert-reference.json's catalog framing, and not previously captured as a relation because there's no existing predicate for 'expires when condition clears' and a single occurrence doesn't yet justify minting one.
